VideoMarkOverlay.description: Burn a watermark into every frame — or into a single still photo: fixed corner / low-opacity centre / floating / tiled. Not tied to any video model; works with any IMAGE batch (MiniMax H3, Wan, LTX, VHS, AnimateDiff...). A single image is just a batch of length 1 and gets laid out from its own width and height. Returns a new tensor; upstream data is never modified.

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: Frame batch to watermark. Any IMAGE output works; the node never modifies it in place.

mode.name: Mode
mode.tooltip:
corner   fixed in one corner (least intrusive, best default)
center   dead centre — keep opacity around 0.15~0.25
floating wanders inside the safe area (hardest to crop out, worst to watch)
tile     repeated across the whole frame — hardest to remove in post

position.name: Corner
position.tooltip: Which corner to use in corner mode. Bottom-right blocks the least; switch to top-left if the platform overlays its own UI (like/share buttons) there.

text.name: Text
text.tooltip: Watermark text. Supports multiple lines — just press Enter.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.tooltip:
Overall opacity. Reference values:
corner 0.75~1.0 / centre 0.12~0.22 / floating 0.25~0.45 / tile 0.10~0.20

scale.name: Width %
scale.tooltip: Watermark width as a percentage of the frame width. Resolution independent — you never have to retune it. 15~25 for text, 8~18 for a logo.

margin.name: Margin
margin.tooltip: Safe margin from the frame edge, in pixels. Floating and tiled stamps respect it too, so nothing ever gets clipped. 24~40 for 736x992; 36~64 for 1080p.

use_text.name: Show text
use_text.tooltip: Turn off to show the logo only without deleting the text.

use_logo.name: Show logo
use_logo.tooltip: Master switch for drawing the logo. Source is either the panel upload (logo_file) or a linked IMAGE on the logo input — the link wins.

layout.name: Layout
layout.tooltip: How logo and text stack when both are present: vertical (logo on top) or horizontal (logo on the left).

color.name: Text colour
color.tooltip: Text colour. Accepts #RRGGBB / #RGB / r,g,b / a colour name.

style.name: Style preset
style.tooltip:
One-click preset for stroke + shadow:
soft            both on but subtle (default) — readable on light and dark footage
plain           both off — cleanest, but may vanish on bright backgrounds
outline         solid stroke only — for footage with extreme contrast swings
outline_shadow  both maxed — most legible, also most noticeable
manual          ignore presets and use the four controls below

use_stroke.name: Stroke
use_stroke.tooltip:
Stroke switch. Only read when style=manual; presets override it.
A stroke is the single biggest reason a watermark feels 'too heavy' — lower stroke_opacity before turning it off.

stroke_width.name: Stroke width
stroke_width.tooltip: Stroke thickness in pixels. Only applies when the stroke is on. 2~4 is plenty.

stroke_opacity.name: Stroke strength
stroke_opacity.tooltip: Opacity of the stroke itself. Lower this first when the watermark feels heavy — it keeps the legibility while losing the hard black outline. 0 = no stroke.

use_shadow.name: Shadow
use_shadow.tooltip:
Shadow switch. Only read when style=manual.
A shadow thickens the silhouette without the hard edge a stroke leaves — but a dark shadow is invisible on night footage.

shadow_color.name: Shadow colour
shadow_color.tooltip: Shadow colour. Dark shadows disappear on dark footage; use a light colour there.

shadow_opacity.name: Shadow strength
shadow_opacity.tooltip: Opacity of the shadow. 0.3~0.5 reads as 'visible outline, not in the way'. 0 = no shadow.

shadow_offset.name: Shadow offset
shadow_offset.tooltip: Shadow offset in pixels (positive = down-right). 4~8 looks natural; 0 turns it into a symmetrical soft glow, which is lighter and costs no margin.

shadow_blur.name: Shadow blur
shadow_blur.tooltip: Shadow blur radius in pixels. Bigger is softer. 6~14 is natural; 0 = a hard duplicate.

angle.name: Rotate
angle.tooltip: Rotate the whole watermark. For tiled marks, -20~-30 is much harder to align and erase.

font.name: Font
font.tooltip: Font. The list is sorted Chinese-first on Windows. To use a font outside the list, put its absolute path in font_file below — that overrides this.

font_file.name: Font file
font_file.tooltip: Absolute path to a font file, e.g. D:/Fonts/Inter.otf. Overrides the font list above.

float_path.name: Float path
float_path.tooltip:
Path followed while floating:
diagonal / horizontal / vertical  constant back-and-forth (triangle wave)
circle                            elliptical loop
random                            uniform random jumps — strongest anti-theft, most jarring to watch

float_cycles.name: Float cycles
float_cycles.tooltip: How many round trips across the whole clip. 1 = one very slow pass; 4~8 = clearly wandering but still readable. For the random path this means 'number of position changes' — try 2x the clip length in seconds. A single still has nothing to travel across: the seed pins it to one spot.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Used by the random float path only. Fix it to reproduce the same positions.

start_pct.name: Appear at
start_pct.tooltip: Where the watermark starts appearing, as a fraction of total length. 0 = from frame one. Only meaningful for multi-frame sequences: a single still counts as frame 0, so this never hides it.

end_pct.name: Disappear at
end_pct.tooltip: Where it stops, as a fraction of total length. 1 = stays to the end. 0.6 → 1.0 shows it only in the last 40%. Only meaningful for multi-frame sequences: a single still counts as frame 0, so this never hides it.

fade_frames.name: Fade frames
fade_frames.tooltip: Fade-in / fade-out length in frames. 0 = hard cut. A single still has nothing to fade, so this does not affect it.

tile_gap.name: Tile gap
tile_gap.tooltip: Spacing between tiled watermarks, in pixels.

logo_file.name: Logo file
logo_file.tooltip: Logo file name relative to ComfyUI's input folder. The visual panel fills this in automatically when you click 'Upload logo'. A linked logo input always wins over this.

text_in.name: External text (link)
text_in.tooltip:
Optional. Feed the text in from another node (any node that builds a string).
When connected and non-empty the wired text wins — whatever you typed in the panel is ignored. Disconnected, or an empty string upstream, falls back to the panel text.
Typical use: while comparing parameter variants (side view / resolutions / LoRA strengths / seeds), splice this run's parameters into the frame so you can tell at a glance which settings produced which result.
Note: it takes one plain string — nothing is filled in for you, so build exactly the text you want upstream.

logo.name: Logo (link)
logo.tooltip: Optional. A PNG logo with an alpha channel. Takes priority over the uploaded logo file.

logo_mask.name: Logo mask
logo_mask.tooltip: Optional. Transparency mask for the logo; falls back to the PNG's own alpha.

VideoMarkTitle.description: Insert black copyright cards (text + logo) at the head and/or tail, optionally padding the audio with matching silence so A/V stays in sync. Audio output is empty when nothing is connected.

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: Frame batch to watermark. Any IMAGE output works; the node never modifies it in place.

fps.name: FPS
fps.tooltip: Frame rate, used to convert seconds into a frame count. Must match the final clip's frame rate or the card length will be off (MiniMax H3 usually outputs 24fps).

where.name: Placement
where.tooltip: head = only at the start, tail = only at the end, both = both ends (each gets a full card of `seconds`).

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.tooltip: Card duration in seconds. Around 2s works well for a copyright notice.

text.name: Text
text.tooltip: Watermark text. Supports multiple lines — just press Enter.

use_text.name: Show text
use_text.tooltip: Turn off to show the logo only without deleting the text.

bg_color.name: Card colour
bg_color.tooltip: Card background colour. Pure black by default.

use_logo.name: Show logo
use_logo.tooltip: Master switch for drawing the logo. Source is either the panel upload (logo_file) or a linked IMAGE on the logo input — the link wins.

layout.name: Layout
layout.tooltip: How logo and text stack when both are present: vertical (logo on top) or horizontal (logo on the left).

logo_scale.name: Logo width %
logo_scale.tooltip: Logo width as a percentage of the frame width.

text_scale.name: Text width %
text_scale.tooltip: Text width as a percentage of the frame width. 20~30 reads well for a credit card.

text_stroke_width.name: Card text stroke
text_stroke_width.tooltip: Text stroke thickness. Give it 2~4 when the background is not pure black.

font.name: Font
font.tooltip: Font. The list is sorted Chinese-first on Windows. To use a font outside the list, put its absolute path in font_file below — that overrides this.

font_file.name: Font file
font_file.tooltip: Absolute path to a font file, e.g. D:/Fonts/Inter.otf. Overrides the font list above.

fade_frames.name: Fade frames
fade_frames.tooltip: Fade-in / fade-out length in frames. 0 = hard cut. A single still has nothing to fade, so this does not affect it.

pad_audio.name: Pad silence
pad_audio.tooltip: Pad the audio with matching silence so adding a head card does not desync A/V. Keep this on whenever music is connected.

logo_file.name: Logo file
logo_file.tooltip: Logo file name relative to ComfyUI's input folder. The visual panel fills this in automatically when you click 'Upload logo'. A linked logo input always wins over this.

text_in.name: External text (link)
text_in.tooltip:
Optional. Feed the text in from another node (any node that builds a string).
When connected and non-empty the wired text wins — whatever you typed in the panel is ignored. Disconnected, or an empty string upstream, falls back to the panel text.
Typical use: while comparing parameter variants (side view / resolutions / LoRA strengths / seeds), splice this run's parameters into the frame so you can tell at a glance which settings produced which result.
Note: it takes one plain string — nothing is filled in for you, so build exactly the text you want upstream.

logo.name: Logo (link)
logo.tooltip: Optional. A PNG logo with an alpha channel. Takes priority over the uploaded logo file.

logo_mask.name: Logo mask
logo_mask.tooltip: Optional. Transparency mask for the logo; falls back to the PNG's own alpha.

audio.name: Audio
audio.tooltip: Optional. Only needed so the node can pad matching silence and pass the track through when a head/tail card is added.

VideoMarkVideo.description: All-in-one: watermark + head/tail cards on a VIDEO, audio handled for you. Use Overlay + Title when you want finer control.

video.name: Video
video.tooltip: VIDEO to process. Frame rate is read from the video itself.
